title: DIALS 3.31.0 Benchmark
heading: DIALS 3.31.0 benchmark report
build_note: DIALS is the 3.31.0 release; dials.version reports it as DIALS 3.31.
dates: 21 November 2026; scaling, export and merging re-run 24 November 2026
note: dials.scale in DIALS 3.31.0 does not choose a resolution limit by itself, so the script scales each dataset twice. The first pass scales all data and prints the limit DIALS suggests, where a fit of CC½ falls to 0.3. The second pass scales the unscaled data again with d_min set to that limit, and the cut data are exported and merged. The resolution, CC½, completeness and multiplicity reported here are for the cut data. Where DIALS suggested no limit, the data are not cut. In all_results.csv, overall_* holds the statistics of the final data, suggested_d_min_cc_half_fit the limit that was applied, and seconds_scale the time of both scaling passes. The script was changed to this form after the first run: steps up to and including the first scaling pass date from 21 November, and only the second pass, export and merging were run again.
